'''Matt Teator''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2002 Durham tournament]] on 17 August 2002 with Dark LSC, according to Lewis Blake's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3919">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-08-18-durham-nc-8-17-02d3919/ durham-nc-8-17-02], DeckTech (Lewis "Duke Devil" Blake, 18 August 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-08-18-durham-nc-8-17-02d3919/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
